sources.title: [2505.07813] DexWild: Dexterous Human Interactions for In-the-Wild ...
sources.snippet: The DexWild learning framework co-trains on both human and robot demonstrations, leading to improved performance compared to training on each dataset individually. This combination results in robust robot policies capable of generalizing to novel environments, tasks, and embodiments with minimal additional robot-specific data.
